races.title: State House, District 24
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: Ryan Chamberlin
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, unopposed. Born in Atlanta in 1974; author and consultant per Wikipedia. Won HD 24 in a 2023 special election (78%) after a five-way primary; succeeded Joe Harding.
cands.local_ties: Files from Marion County; Wikipedia gives no city.

record.text: Won the March 2023 special Republican primary and the May 2023 special election for HD 24.
Led a medical coalition for his 2023 bid.

controversies.text: His Wikipedia article describes a 2023 defamation suit by rival primary candidate Jose Juarez against a consulting firm and a political committee over campaign claims; it settled with a public apology. The defendants were the firm and committee, not Chamberlin.

cands.gaps: Website, donors and endorsements not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
